Blast at Moscow Restaurant Kills Three, Injures Over 20

A blast occurred outside an Italian restaurant in Moscow's Kudrinskaya Square on Saturday evening, killing three people and injuring at least 21. The Moscow Investigative Committee stated the attack was under investigation. Reports indicate a homemade bomb carried by a woman exploded, killing her along with two others. The Moscow mayor described the incident as a 'terrorist act'.
